ns2:section.sectionText: Campus Honors Program: “French Food for Thought”: An exploration of the historical and sociological impact of French food culture on western societies. The course unpacks why French food holds such an important place in western society and how it came to be. It will also look closely at certain food types to understand their prominence in every day cuisine. This section for Chancellor's Scholars only; other students may only enroll with consent of instructor and the Campus Honors Program
